title: Tenant data placement constraints operator and automated evidence stream
creator: Priya Rao
description: Add a tenant-level operator and UI workflow that lets customers declare data placement constraints (region anchors and soft-preferences), per-tenant retention TTLs for transient KV/prefix caches, and an automated evidence stream that packages signed residency+retention proofs for auditors. Goal: provide a simple, auditable control surface for hosted API customers to assert where request data and derived artifacts live, and to retrieve periodic evidence bundles without custom SRE work.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/placement - accepts placement_policy with fields {primary_regions, failover_regions, enforcement_mode} and returns 202 with validation errors
Console: New "Placement Wizard" in tenant settings that walks customers through anchor vs soft preference, retention TTL sliders, and preview of audit bundle contents
Runtime: Router honors placement_policy and routes new requests to primary_regions when available, failing over to failover_regions while tagging evidence with chosen route and policy version
Retention: Per-tenant cache retention TTLs applied to KV cache and ephemeral storage; metrics emitted (cache_ttl_sec, cache_evictions) and surfaced in Console
Evidence: Automated daily evidence bundle produced per-tenant (signed by Redwood KMS) containing manifest, routing logs, retention policy snapshot, and proof-of-deletion markers for expired items
Operations: Admin API to simulate placement decisions for a tenant for debugging and exportable timeline for incidents
Security: Security review completed and HSM/KMS signing keys provisioned, key rotation documented
notes_and_updates: 2026-03-10 - Kickoff: PM, Eng runtime, Console UX, and Security aligned on objectives. Prioritized as P1 for regulated customers planning Q2 rollouts.

2026-03-11 - Eng asks to define enforcement_mode values clearly. Decided on three modes: strict (reject requests outside primary regions), soft (prefer primary but allow failover), audit-only (no routing changes, only record policy).

2026-03-12 - Security: recommended signed evidence manifests using current KMS; requested threat model for proof-of-deletion markers (will use deterministic tombstone logs + signed manifest referencing storage URIs).

2026-03-13 - UX: mockups for Placement Wizard done (link below). Requested confirmation text and export button for generated evidence bundles. Also proposed a per-tenant timeline view in Console for placement changes.

2026-03-14 - Engineering: preliminary router change approved. Runtime will implement policy versioning to ensure rollbacks and immutable evidence references. Next: ENG-24871 to implement placement API and ENG-24872 for runtime routing adapter. Scheduling spikes for kernel/latency regression testing because extra routing checks could affect p95.
